newsitem.title: USA: United Cities, Atmos say merger hits snag.
newsitem.headline: United Cities, Atmos say merger hits snag.

text.p: Atmos Energy Corp and United Cities Gas Co said Wednesday that an Illinois hearing examiner recommended, in a proposed order, that the state's Commerce Commission deny the companies' petition to merge.

Although the hearing examiner said the proposed structure of the merger was appropriate, the companies said he noted they need to provide more information on the benefits of the merger to Illinois ratepayers.
In November shareholders of both companies approved the merger in which Atmos would be the surviving entity.

The companies issued a statement saying the merger is subject to regulatory approvals in 10 of the 13 states in which the combined companies would have operations. To date, the companies said they have approvals in all states but Illinois.
